audience: Shopify merchants who show Rebuy product recommendations to shoppers

useCases.title: Find cross-sell products for a product page
useCases.text: Read the products that convert best next to a product. Read similar products for the same item.

useCases.title: Check top sellers and trending products
useCases.text: List the store's top-selling products, optionally within a product list. List the products trending now.

useCases.title: Test a custom ruleset for a cart
useCases.text: Run one of the store's custom rulesets for a cart or product context. Read the products it returns.

useCases.title: List products in a collection
useCases.text: List the products of one or more collections, with optional smart sorting. Read a fixed, merchant-curated list by product id or handle.

useCases.title: Show what a shopper bought or viewed
useCases.text: Read the products one shopper bought before. Read the products a shopper viewed, from Rebuy's view events.
